changelog: NEW (Auto cache-clear on launch): Several support reports said 'clearing cache fixed it'. The app now does that automatically on launch. Mimics what Fire OS Settings → Apps → HushTV → Clear Cache does — wipes the Coil bitmap cache, Xtream HTTP JSON cache, downloaded subtitles, and cached home-screen rail layout — but keeps everything that is actually 'data' (your license, playlists, prefs, sync state, sign-in). Throttled to once per 6 hours so rapid restarts don't re-download images repeatedly. TV-remote users no longer have to navigate Fire OS settings to clear cache.
FIX (v526): Disabled EmojiCompat + ProfileInstaller startup initializers — fewer disk I/O hits during cold launch.
FIX (v525): Fire Stick black-screen-on-play — SurfaceView for Lite mode.
FIX (v524): Migration moved off main thread.
